# `/data-segments` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /data-segments/v1/membership/{identityId}

`getDataSegmentIdentityMembershipV1` — Get segmentmembership by identity id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the segment membership specified by the given identity ID.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — The identity ID to retrieve the segments they are in.
- Returns 200: object

### GET /data-segments/v1/user-enabled/{identityId}

`getDataSegmentationEnabledForUserV1` — Is segmentation enabled by identity — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns whether or not segmentation is enabled for the identity.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — The identity ID to retrieve if segmentation is enabled for the identity.
- Returns 200: boolean

### GET /data-segments/v1/{segmentId}

`getDataSegmentV1` — Get segment by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the segment specified by the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `segmentId` (path, required) — The segment ID to retrieve.
- Returns 200: data-segment

### POST /data-segments/v1/{segmentId}

`publishDataSegmentV1` — Publish segment by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This will publish the segment so that it starts applying the segmentation to the desired users if enabled

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `publishAll` (query) — default True — This flag decides whether you want to publish all unpublished or a list of specific segment ids
  - `segmentId` (path, required) — The segmentId.
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 200: no body

### PATCH /data-segments/v1/{segmentId}

`patchDataSegmentV1` — Update segment — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to update segment fields by using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `segmentId` (path, required) — The segment ID to modify.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 200: data-segment

### DELETE /data-segments/v1/{segmentId}

`deleteDataSegmentV1` — Delete segment by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API deletes the segment specified by the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `segmentId` (path, required) — The segment ID to delete.
  - `published` (query) — default False — This determines which version of the segment to delete
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /data-segments/v1

`listDataSegmentsV1` — Get segments — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the segment specified by the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `enabled` (query) — default True — This boolean indicates whether the segment is currently active. Inactive segments have no effect.
  - `unique` (query) — default False — This returns only one record if set to true and that would be the published record if exists.
  - `published` (query) — default True — This boolean indicates whether the segment is being applied to the accounts. If unpublished its being actively modified until published
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in, sw; name: eq, in, sw — e.g. `name eq ""`
- Returns 200: array of data-segment

### POST /data-segments/v1

`createDataSegmentV1` — Create segment — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API creates a segment. >**Note:** Segment definitions may take time to propagate to all identities.

- Scopes: idn:data-segment:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): data-segment
- Returns 201: data-segment
